assumptions: The estimate assumes parallel non-overlapping implementation lanes, a clean finding-free cycle, available independent review, and no entitlement or review delay.

The clean milestone sequence targets readiness on Day 17; the 16-20 working-day range preserves bounded exact-SHA evidence closeout, supported finding repair, and fresh review allowance without weakening a gate.
Engineering compression never waives LOCAL_TEST_GO, P1-03/P1-04 acceptance, P1-06 readiness GO, exact-SHA identity, evidence, restart, reconciliation, resource, or zero-effects gates.

After readyAtMs, the accepted prospective calendar derives S1, captures the candidate frame through S5, publishes the immutable manifest before S6, rehearses operations during S6-S14, and begins real collection at S15.
The mandatory S1-S15 prospective lead and the exactly 65-regular-session recording window cannot be compressed by engineering parallelism or automation.
This documentation update does not authorize provider access, local-corpus execution, production-runtime provisioning, real-company selection, or recording.

corpusDefinition: Freeze one canonical manifest containing at least 200 unique event-case identities, source/artifact identities, expected disposition, session/calendar authority, and deterministic ordering before execution.
Use only original synthetic fixtures and already-authorized locally retained recorded artifacts; perform no provider, network, credential, account, or spending call.

Treat these as local validation cases, not a P2 StudyManifest or scientific cohort. Case variants, restart prefixes, and replay permutations do not alter the accepted exact 180-cluster P2 design or its fixed denominators.
Include accepted, missing, malformed, duplicate, corrected, quarantined, terminal, expiry, erasure-reappearance, and stop-race cases; prohibit substitutions or post-run corpus edits.
runtimeProvisioning: Provision a clean OS-access-controlled PEAS_RUNTIME_ROOT through the explicit owned first-boot path only when the complete runtime layout is absent.
Pin the executable SHA/tree, dependency lockfile, Node/npm and SQLite versions, OS build, timezone/clock basis, filesystem root, migration set, and owned process/deployment identity.
Run isolated memory and SQLite compositions with effects disabled, no broker/order surface, no environment credentials, and outbound network denial; retain logs and runtime-root inventory.
Treat a missing authority anchor while any primary acquisition or retention state exists as terminal corruption; do not reconstruct authority from mutable primary records.
exactConfigurationManifest: Candidate SHA/tree and build digest; corpus-manifest digest; fixture/artifact digests and sizes; provider/entitlement, calendar/session, corpus-admission, clock, and stage-ledger authority identities.

Acquisition/request identities, origin/path/query plan, page and worker limits, deterministic seed/order, retry/quota/deadline values, attempt and acquisition budgets, retention/expiry/erasure settings, and trusted-time source.
Memory/SQLite backend, runtime-root identity, schema and migration versions, checkpoint/restart schedule, reconciliation mode, effect-disable assertions, and resource-measurement commands.

acceptanceThresholds.manifestCoverage: 100% of frozen event cases accounted for; zero substitution, deletion, duplicate identity, or untyped missing result
acceptanceThresholds.effects: zero network/provider/credential/account calls and zero broker, order, portfolio, position, fill, dispatchable, spending, or financial-effect rows
acceptanceThresholds.integrity: zero digest, size, provider, request, artifact, ledger, page-chain, retention, receipt, lineage, or evidence-union mismatch
acceptanceThresholds.replay: byte-identical semantic outputs, identities, reasons, counters, and evidence across repeated runs, order/page permutations, and memory/SQLite
acceptanceThresholds.restart: zero advancement from an unverified checkpoint and identical terminal output from every reachable durable checkpoint prefix
acceptanceThresholds.cleanup: zero orphan worker, timer, transport, body, stream, reader, writer lease, SQLite fence, snapshot, or active retention operation
acceptanceThresholds.resources: no accepted contract maximum may be exceeded; preserve the existing 15,000 ms processing-CPU scale bound and treat wall time as diagnostic host-delay evidence only

deterministicReplay: Replay the complete frozen ledger-to-artifact set in canonical order and adversarial order/page-size permutations, then compare full canonical bytes and evidence inventories.
Require exact memory/SQLite equivalence, cold-restart equivalence, stable missing/quarantine reasons, and zero later-item access after terminal facts.
restartCoverage: Restart memory and SQLite execution at every reachable checkpoint prefix for every transition class represented by the corpus, including acquisition, page commit/verification, normalization, derived lineage, stop, expiry, erasure, receipt revalidation, reconciliation, and quarantine recovery.

Include crash/hard-kill points around credential claim, writer lease/fence renewal and release, artifact link/commit, source removal, ownership registration, denial, erasure, and receipt-version commit.
integrityAndReconciliation: Reconcile ledger, artifacts, page proofs, normalized facts, derived lineage, retention ownership, denials, tombstones, erasure attempts/receipts, quarantine actions, snapshots, and physical copy state with exact set equality.
Revalidate absence and denial when a receipt already exists, count unique physical (digest, attemptOrdinal) attempts, and prove no stale receipt or post-stop mutation survives restart.
resourceMeasurements: Record processing CPU and diagnostic wall time, peak RSS/heap, artifact and SQLite bytes, open files/handles, workers, timers, readers, streams, leases/fences, reconciliation duration, per-case throughput, and cleanup latency.
Compare exact maxima and one-over vectors to the accepted resource contracts; preserve raw measurements and host-isolation diagnostics without relaxing deterministic bounds.
effectsDisabledLocalValidation.finalDecision: Return LOCAL_TEST_GO only if the frozen manifest, exact configuration, all thresholds, deterministic replay, restart matrix, integrity/reconciliation, resource evidence, effects-disabled proof, and independent review pass on unchanged bytes. Otherwise preserve LOCAL_TEST_NO_GO with exact reproductions; no waiver, corpus substitution, or later-scope authorization is implied.

findingsClosed: Credential use is ordered after all rejectable non-secret validation, rooted in owned durable workflow evidence, bound to the exact request identity and destination/query plan, one-shot, physically applied by the owned transport, and released at attempt settlement.

Historical page admission requires authenticated complete-chain and authoritative wire-semantic evidence; missing, gapped, substituted, looped, repeated, multiple-terminal, post-terminal, and semantic-forgery chains emit no trusted records.

Replay and restart require exact ledger-to-artifact coverage, complete expectation tuples, provider/request/artifact identity pinning, exact checkpoint transitions, and verified checkpoints before advancement.

Owned schedulers enforce absolute attempt and acquisition deadlines across dispatch, storage, cancellation, cleanup, and settlement; pending-forever dependencies cannot prevent deterministic terminal return.
Trusted retention enforcement covers every read, derived use, normalization, reconciliation, stop, expiry, erasure, and receipt-revalidation path, including cross-instance races and cold restart.

Artifact commit, byte/digest verification, ownership, derived lineage, provider-stop state, physical erasure-attempt accounting, and versioned receipt correction are durably coupled with memory/SQLite equivalence.

Owned runtime roots reject structural adapters, raw SQLite handles, proxies, subclasses, method shadows, public evidence minting, and caller-created authority; missing anchors with existing primary state fail closed.

Writer renewal/fence release, reconciliation cancellation, read admission, quarantine last-copy recovery, terminal visited-item counters, and exception-safe secret snapshot zeroing are deterministic across restart and hard-kill.
tasks.threatModelBoundary: Trust is rooted in the correctly provisioned, OS-access-controlled PEAS_RUNTIME_ROOT and the owned PEAS process/deployment identity. Ordinary application callers, public APIs, structural SQLite adapters, raw handles, proxies, subclasses, and caller-authored journals/evidence are untrusted and cannot mint production authority. An administrator able to replace the entire OS-protected runtime root, executable, configuration, and all local authority state is outside this accepted PR threat model; requiring resistance to that actor would be a new product/contract decision.
nonGoals: No provider/API/market-data call, credential/account inspection, copied provider payload, provider witness, fallback, new spend, or financial effect.
No new public endpoint, field, provider role, commercial capability, policy, port, or broader product contract.
No P1-03/P1-04 implementation, P1-06 execution, P2 corpus collection, study outcome, model/trading threshold, broker/order path, or later project scope.
No hardware counter, external signing service, network authority, or defense against privileged replacement of all OS-protected local state.
